## 说明

该函数对渔获量最大的`top_n`个物种的渔获量序列进行突变点分析（平均渔获量的变化，`strucchange::breakpoints`），并统计每年有多少个物种发生变化。许多物种在同一年发生变化，可能意味着整个生态系统发生了突变（regime shift），也可能源于渔业管理或数据上报方式的改变。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function runs a breakpoint analysis (changes in the mean catch, `strucchange::breakpoints`)
on the catch series of the `top_n` species with the largest catch, and counts how many species
change in each year. Years in which many species change together may point to an ecosystem-wide
regime shift, or to changes in fisheries management or reporting.

</details>

## 用法

```r
regime_shift(
  area_data,
  top_n = 20,
  h_value = 0.15,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  label = NULL
)
```

## 参数

`area_data`
:   FAO渔获数据：`fishing_area_data()$area_data`，或`load_fao_data()`的任意子集（例如一个国家，或几个渔区）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    FAO catch data: `fishing_area_data()$area_data`, or any subset of
    `load_fao_data()` (e.g. one country, or several fishing areas).

    </details>

`top_n`
:   要分析的物种数，取总渔获量最大的物种。默认为20。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The number of species with the largest total catch to analyse. Default is 20.

    </details>

`h_value`
:   传给`strucchange::breakpoints()`的最小分段长度：序列长度的比例（默认为0.15）或年数。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The minimum segment size passed to `strucchange::breakpoints()`: a fraction of
    the series length (default 0.15) or a number of years.

    </details>

`plot`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，图表保存在figures/png/summary/。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE (default), charts are saved in `figures/png/summary/`.

    </details>

`table`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in `tables/`.

    </details>

`lang`
:   图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or
    "both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
    `fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).

    </details>

`pptx`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/summary/。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE, charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in
    `figures/pptx/summary/`. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with
    `fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`.

    </details>

`label`
:   输出文件名中使用的名称。默认为数据所属的渔区（或国家）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The name used in the output file names. Default is the fishing area (or the
    country) of the data.

    </details>

## 返回值

以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含`breakpoints`（每个物种一行）和`yearly`（每年出现突变点的物种数）。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

Invisibly, a list with `breakpoints` (one row per species) and `yearly` (number of
species with a breakpoint in each year).

</details>

## 详细说明

突变点的年份是新时段的第一年。序列太短、不满足`h_value`的物种会被跳过，并给出提示信息。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

The year of a breakpoint is the first year of the new segment. Species whose series is too
short for `h_value` are skipped with a message.

</details>

## 示例

```r
FAO34 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central", plot = FALSE)
regime_shift(FAO34$area_data, lang = "zh")
```
